استعفينا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْفَيْنَا (istaʕfaynā) /is.taʕ.faj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اُسْتُعْفِينَا (ustuʕfīnā) /us.tuʕ.fiː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
